name: catalyst-electrobun-boilerplate
description: Monorepo boilerplate with Catalyst web app and Electrobun desktop shell

scripts.setup: npm run setup:web && npm run setup:desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,DESKTOP -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/web && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build:ui
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
